2123160416121504104.en_summary: Palo Alto Networks ($PANW) has agreed to acquire AI startup Applied Compute for $4.5B in an all-stock deal. Applied Compute helps businesses train and run custom AI models; CEO Yash Patil to become co-chief AI officer. Premium of roughly 38% to recent $3.25B valuation.
2123160416121504104.zh_summary: Palo Alto Networks（$PANW）同意以 45 億美元全股票交易收購 AI 新創 Applied Compute。該公司協助企業訓練與運行自訂 AI 模型；執行長 Yash Patil 將出任共同首席 AI 官。較近期 32.5 億美元估值溢價約 38%。

ticker_notes.PANW: 以 45 億美元全股票收購 Applied Compute，溢價約 38%
